instruction:
Directly reorganize the rule set in the real native Altium board file `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\wifi_board.PcbDoc` instead of exporting XML. Save the modified native document as `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\wifi_ruleset.PcbDoc` in Altium Designer.

Requirements:
- In rule `Clearance_Diff_pair`, change the intra-pair clearance to `8mil` and keep the rule scoped to `InAnyDifferentialPair`.
- Change rule `Width` to `MINLIMIT=8mil`, `PREFEREDWIDTH=10mil`, and `MAXLIMIT=12mil`.
- Change rule `RoutingVias` to `HOLEWIDTH=12mil`, and set `WIDTH`, `MINWIDTH`, and `MAXWIDTH` all to `28mil`.

This task evaluates rule-object maintenance inside the native `.PcbDoc`, not rewriting the rules into external XML.
source: Local Altium example `Mini PC - WiFi/WiFi.PcbDoc`; benchmark task restored from text-only rule-export generation to native rule editing.
